Events created in the app use Vietnam time (UTC+7); ICS events retain their imported time zones. Without precise-alarm access, Android may delay reminders. Sound and vibration follow the system notification channel.
Events, profiles and preferences stay on this device. No account, advertisements or server uploads.
Calendar calculations use UTC+7 for 1900–2100. Historical dates follow modern Vietnamese rules; regional calendars before 1968 are not reconstructed.

Lịch Việt uses precise-alarm access to remind you at the times you choose for saved events. Without it, reminders still work but Android may deliver them later. You can change this permission in system Settings.

The Vietnamese lunar calendar is calculated from new moons and solar longitude at UTC+7. It uses Meeus astronomy formulas, with reference to Sonia Keys’ MIT-licensed code and tests against NASA astronomy data.

Auspicious dates and hours are cultural reference based on rules documented in the project. Birth charts use a specific edition of Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu, identified on the Chart screen; unverified features are marked.
